q1.finding_flow: Today a TICKER_NOT_FOUND finding starts at the provider check. The door collects the upload's symbols and calls the resolver (uploads.py:602); the resident session wires it to UploadTemplateResolver (resident_session.py:145), which returns the rows keyed by symbol (resolution_broker.py:146). SecurityResolver.check marks each symbol FOUND, NOT_FOUND, AMBIGUOUS or UNAVAILABLE and sends every still-NOT_FOUND symbol once, as one batch, to the yfinance checker (security_resolution.py:305-307, 315-349). A KEPT verdict becomes state KEPT, reason YFINANCE_HISTORY, provider_receipt None (security_resolution.py:334). The dict is passed as security_checks into freeze_template_portfolio (uploads.py:618). For each template row the freeze reads checks.get(symbol) (portfolio.py:476). A row is accepted only as a KEPT-by-history check (portfolio.py:486 via _kept_by_history, 376-385) or as a FOUND check with one candidate and a complete 64-hex receipt (portfolio.py:487-494). Any other state is turned into a finding and the loop continues. NOT_FOUND emits TICKER_NOT_FOUND through emit, whose severity defaults to ERROR, with actions REPLACE_FILE and NAME_PROXY and the file's own symbol as value (portfolio.py:440, 500-501). The continue at portfolio.py:518 skips the row. Any ERROR finding, or any template row missing from rows, returns NEEDS_CORRECTION with the findings and the template (portfolio.py:578-579). The door then answers NEEDS_CORRECTION with the findings, the plain words from the table (uploads.py:69-71, _with_correction_words at uploads.py:185-202) and the template (uploads.py:494-497 on the first pass; uploads.py:533-542 on a re-read; uploads.py:569-587 on the resolving path). The upload is stored as NEEDS_CORRECTION (uploads.py:581). The only accepted resolution today is a correction re-post: template_corrections accepts TICKER_NOT_FOUND with from_value and to_value differing (portfolio.py:364, 389-406), and the freeze replaces the symbol before the check (portfolio.py:446, 475). The page reads only the findings words (analysisRequest.ts:253-260). AMOUNT: for a TICKER_NOT_FOUND row the amount is never read. The loop continues at portfolio.py:518, before the amount parse at portfolio.py:519-520, so no dollars are computed and nothing is added to totals (portfolio.py:575 is not reached). No normalized document is frozen, because rows is shorter than template rows (portfolio.py:578). The amount survives only as the text template_reader wrote at template_reader.py:483, echoed inside the NEEDS_CORRECTION template. It is not priced, not stored as a holding, and in no total. A row whose amount is not a number is handled separately (portfolio.py:524).

q2.client_action_proposal: Reuse the correction shape the envelope already carries; add no action name and no wire member. The page re-posts the SAME upload_token and file_base64 with body.corrections holding one item {finding_code: TICKER_NOT_FOUND, from_value: <the file's symbol>, to_value: <the same symbol>} for Keep. The wire item is closed with three fields and only a pattern on the two values, so equal values pass the wire (AnalysisUploadRequest.schema.json, base blob, not cited). The server refuses equal values today (portfolio.py:401, pinned by test_y5_proxy_corrections.py:99), so the server change is: accept an equal pair only for finding_code TICKER_NOT_FOUND, and in the freeze turn a NOT_FOUND row named by such a pair into an UNRESOLVED row instead of a finding (today the NOT_FOUND branch at portfolio.py:500-501 emits and continues). A new action name is not needed and would be refused if it reached the status envelope (ops/status.py:75, 226-227). The Keep is disclosed per upload: each correction is recorded with approved_by = the posting principal (portfolio.py:593). The Use path is unchanged: to_value = the suggested symbol, same as today.
q2.retained_row_shape: A normalized row for a kept unresolved ticker, in the same dict the KEPT row uses (portfolio.py:562-564, 568-570): original = the template row (symbol, amount, cells) as today; security_id = the typed symbol, unchanged (provider_id equals the symbol, portfolio.py:481, as the KEPT row already does); analysis_dollars = the amount as text, for the USD basis only (portfolio.py:528, 563; weights need the notional at portfolio.py:538; SHARES needs a quote at portfolio.py:543-559 and keeps refusing SHARES_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE, pinned by test_kept_holding.py:225-230); price = null (the quote is None on USD, portfolio.py:563); provider_receipt_sha256 = null (portfolio.py:564, the KEPT value); resolution = UNRESOLVED (a NEW field, written nowhere today); method = a NEW value, for example KEPT_AS_TYPED (the existing KEPT_BY_HISTORY at portfolio.py:568 must NOT be reused, its words claim price history); price_source = null (today yfinance, portfolio.py:568); history = absent or null (today the checker rows and last_close, portfolio.py:569-570). The row must not enter the holdings totals (portfolio.py:575, 596-597) and counts as a row for the row-count check (portfolio.py:578). Its dollars therefore sit in the document only as a row, not in total_dollars or the notional reconciliation (portfolio.py:591).

q4.contract_for_y2: REQUEST. POST analysis-input-upload with the SAME upload_token and file_base64 as the first post, plus body.corrections (at most 20 items, one per from_value). Use: {finding_code: TICKER_NOT_FOUND, from_value: <symbol as the finding value>, to_value: <suggested symbol>} (unchanged). Keep: {finding_code: TICKER_NOT_FOUND, from_value: <symbol>, to_value: <the same symbol>}. Keep is refused with CORRECTIONS_INVALID until the server change lands; the portal must not send it before then. The page must send only finding_code TICKER_NOT_FOUND for a Keep, and never a swap to a symbol the filer did not choose. RESPONSE. state NORMALIZED with input_id and portfolio, or NEEDS_CORRECTION with findings (each finding: code, row, column, value, actions, description). A kept row appears in portfolio.holdings only if the CTO rules it may (the recommendation excludes it from totals). A kept row carries resolution UNRESOLVED, security_id = the typed symbol, analysis_dollars = the typed amount (USD basis), price null, provider_receipt_sha256 null. The page must word it as NOT PRICED, pending C-SWAP. The analysis submit proceeds on input_id as today; the report boundary (read_holdings) refuses an UNRESOLVED row until C-SWAP files it resolved. Which of these the submit may do is the CTO's call, not this read's.

recommendation.smallest_safe_change: No wire change and no new action. Server: accept an equal from_value and to_value pair only for finding_code TICKER_NOT_FOUND (intake/portfolio.py template_corrections), and in the freeze turn a NOT_FOUND row named by such a pair into an UNRESOLVED row (resolution UNRESOLVED, method a new KEPT_AS_TYPED value, price_source and history null, provider_receipt_sha256 null) that is excluded from totals and counted as a row. Consumers: ycharts/generate/normalized_input.py prepare_normalized_upload refuses an UNRESOLVED row before the vendor upload, and ycharts/research/runner.py read_holdings refuses it before the rows are built. Portal (Y2): the Keep posts the equal pair; the Use path is unchanged.
recommendation.risk_note: What it could widen. (1) An unpriced row reaching a report as priced: read_holdings must refuse, because opal_producer.py drops the marker at line 220 and layout_overview.py prices any row it receives at line 281; the existing KEPT_BY_HISTORY path already reaches these readers with a receipt-less row. (2) The Keep must apply only in the NOT_FOUND branch: an equal pair on a FOUND symbol would otherwise create a second, unpriced row beside a priced holding. (3) Equal-pair acceptance widens what an uploader can file: each Keep is audited through corrections with approved_by (portfolio.py:593), and the per-upload cap is 20 (portfolio.py:394). (4) If the UNRESOLVED dollars enter holdings totals, total_dollars and the notional reconciliation move (portfolio.py:575, 591, 596). (5) normalized_input.py line 64 already raises TypeError on a receipt-less KEPT row (static reading, not run), so the normalized_input edit must fix it in the same release. (6) A refusal that stops being a refusal: if read_holdings does not refuse, the report is priced at client-typed dollars with no provider check. (7) test_y5_proxy_corrections.py line 99 pins a case-only pair ('TIMXX' to 'timxx') as CORRECTIONS_INVALID; a comparison that ignores case would silently turn that refusal into a Keep, so the rule must compare the exact strings or the CTO must rule the case-only pair.
